endorsements.name: Daniel Chechik
endorsements.label: Utilizing Popular Websites for Malicious Purposes Using RDI
endorsements.description: Reflected DOM Injection is a new attack vector that will be unveiled for the first time in our talk! We will explain the technique and show a live demo where we use it to hide malicious code within popular and trusted websites.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 21

evidence-links.title: DEF CON 21 - Daniel Chechik and Anat Fox Davidi - Utilizing Popular Websites for Malicious Purposes

endorsements.name: Daniel Chechik
endorsements.label: Bitcoin Transaction Malleability Theory in Practice
endorsements.description: A mysterious vulnerability from 2011 almost made the Bitcoin network collapse. Silk Road, MTGox, and potentially many more trading websites claim to be prone to "Transaction Malleability." We will shed some light and show in practice how to exploit this vulnerability.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2014
